ai_summary.text:
GMOペイメントゲートウェイはオンライン決済代行の最大手。IFRS適用。ECサイト・アプリの決済処理、対面決済端末、後払い決済「GMO後払い」を展開し、年間決済処理件数は国内トップクラス。

売上825億円（前年比+11.8%）と二桁増収。営業利益313億円（営業利益率38%）、純利益218億円と増収増益。38%の営業利益率はフィンテック企業として極めて高く、決済トランザクション手数料の積み上げモデルが高収益を実現。ROE19.3%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率27.8%は決済事業の預り金が総資産を膨らませた影響、財務健全性スコア75点。営業CF538億円、FCF464億円と潤沢なキャッシュ創出。EPS288円に対しPER28.8倍、配当144円。キャッシュレス決済比率の上昇が構造的な成長ドライバーであり、決済インフラのプラットフォーム価値は高まり続けている。なお、EPS287.8円、PER28.8倍、1株当たり配当金144.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: GMO Payment Gateway is the largest online payment processing company. IFRS applied. It develops payment processing for EC sites and apps, face-to-face payment terminals, and deferred payment "GMO Deferred Payment," and the annual payment processing volume is one of the largest in Japan.  Revenue increased by double digits to  82.5 billion (up 11.8% year-on-year). Operating profit was  31.3 billion (operating profit margin of 38%) and net profit was  21.8 billion, resulting in increased revenue and profit. The operating profit margin of 38% is extremely high as a fintech company, and the accumulation model of payment transaction fees has achieved high profitability. High capital efficiency with an ROE of 19.3%.  The equity ratio of 27.8% is due to the effect of deposits in the payment business inflating total assets, with a financial soundness score of 75 points. Abundant cash generation with operating CF of  53.8 billion and FCF of  46.4 billion. At EPS of  288 and PER of 28.8x, the dividend is  144. The increase in the cashless payment ratio is a structural growth driver, and the platform value of the payment infrastructure continues to increase. The company is at a level of EPS  287.8, PER 28.8x, and dividend per share of  144.0, and is promoting management that balances shareholder returns and enhancement of corporate value.
